source: Your mastery of called shots is unparalleled. and you gain %d%% bonus critical chance and %d%% critical damage with your Called Shots Talents. At rank 3 the cooldowns of all of your Called Shots Talents are reduced by 2 each. At rank 5 you gain %d%% Physical resistance penetration with all Called Shot attacks.
target:
你对射击的掌握程度无与伦比。你的精准射击系技能获得 %d%% 额外暴击几率和 %d%% 额外暴击伤害。
		在第 3 级时，所有精准射击系技能冷却时间降低两回合。
		在第 5 级时，你的精准射击技能获得 %d%% 物理抗性穿透。

source: Highers are a special branch of Humans that have been imbued with latent magic since the Age of Allure.
target: 自厄流纪起，高等人类就是人类种族的一支特殊分支，他们的身体里潜藏着魔力。

source: You channel ooze through your psiblades.
target: 你向心灵利刃里灌注软泥能量。

source: @Source@ explodes! @target@ is enveloped in searing light.
target: @Source@爆炸了！@target@ 被灼热的光线覆盖了。

source: None that you know of has come back yet, but you did survive Reknor. You are great.
target: 据你所知没有一个人能活着回来，不过你从瑞库纳幸存了下来，你比较牛 X。
法杖 增加自然抗性穿透

source:
Hits the target doing %d%% damage. If the attack hits, the target is stunned for %d turns.
		The chance to stun improves with your Physical Power.
target:
攻击目标造成 %d%% 伤害。如果攻击命中则可震慑目标 %d 回合。
		震慑几率受物理强度加成。

source: An old orc, covered in battle scars, he looks fierce and very, very, dangerous.
target: 一只浑身都是伤疤的年老兽人，他看起来异常的凶残和危险。

surface_observation: “eaten raw”是生吃，译为“生吞活剥”增加了活剥之意

source: Turn into a spectre to move around the battlefield.
target: 化为游魂，在战场上四处游荡。

source: Summons three to six blazing fires.
target: 召唤三到六个燃烧之炎。

source: The target is cursed, reducing all resistances by %d%%.
target: 目标被诅咒，全体伤害抗性降低 %d%%。

source: The target is in a nightmarish sleep, suffering %0.2f darkness damage each turn and unable to to perform most actions.  Every %d damage it takes will reduce the duration of the effect by one turn.
target: 目标陷入噩梦般的沉睡，每回合受到 %0.2f 暗影伤害，并且无法执行大多数行动。每受到 %d 点伤害，效果持续时间便减少 1 回合。

source: There are also rumours of a renegade Shaloren camp to the west.
target: 有传闻说西面有堕落的永恒精灵的营地。

source: Fragmented essence... maybe it'd be best if it stayed fragmented.
target: 精华碎片……如果它仍然呈碎裂状态就好了。

source: Unlock all interface elements so they can be moved and resized.
target: 解锁所有界面元素，使其可以移动和改变大小。

source: A mature cold drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
target: 一条成年冰龙，拥有冰冷刺骨的吐息和锋利的爪子。

source:
Welcome, wandering one! The Wanderer class uses a randomly selected set of talent trees.
You can now choose how this set is selected:
target:
欢迎，流浪者！流浪者职业具有随机的技能树。
现在你将选择随机模式：

source: Subtle applications of the psionic arts.

deep_observation: 冻结源码锚点：tome，commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，game/modules/tome/init.lua:92。fiery explosions 的火焰含义被译成“强大的爆炸”；travel with a sturdy golem 描述与坚固傀儡同行，译文改为“可以召唤傀儡”，遗漏坚固及同行信息并改变陈述内容。
source: Alchemists can transmute gems to create fiery explosions, and are known to travel with a sturdy golem for extra protection.
surface_observation: 将 fiery explosions 译为强大的爆炸，并将 travel with a sturdy golem 译为召唤傀儡，改变了原意
target: 炼金术士可以转化宝石制造强大的爆炸，同时他们还可以召唤傀儡来守护他们。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A tall woman stands before you. Her fair skin radiates incredible power through her white robe.*#WHITE#
I am Linaniil of the Kar'Krul. Welcome to our city, @playerdescriptor.subclass@. What may I do for thee?
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一名身材高大的女子伫立在你面前。她白皙的肌肤透过白袍散发着惊人的力量。*#WHITE#
我是卡·克鲁尔的莱娜尼尔。欢迎来到我们的城市，@playerdescriptor.subclass@。我能为你做些什么？

deep_observation: “增加你同样数值的状态抵抗”混淆了伤害抗性与状态抵抗。补查：tome，commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，game/modules/tome/data/talents/cursed/dark-sustenance.lua:63-73 将 resistGain 传给 EFF_FEED；game/modules/tome/data/timed_effects/other.lua:3846-3855 遍历目标 resists 并通过 self:addTemporaryValue("resists", gainList) 增加自身对应伤害抗性，3940-3949 同时降低目标对应伤害抗性。
source:
Enhances your feeding by reducing your targeted foe's resistances, multiplying them by %0.2f and increasing your resistances by the amount drained. Resistance to "all" is not affected.
		Improves with your Mindpower.
surface_observation: 将目标的伤害抗性降低后，译文却说增加自身的状态抵抗；resistances 指伤害抗性
target:
提高你的吸食能力，将目标的伤害抗性降低到原来的 %0.2f 倍，并增加你同样数值的状态抵抗。
		对“所有”抗性无效。
		效果受精神强度加成。

source:
The fungus on your body allows regeneration effects to last longer.
		Each time you gain a beneficial effect with the regeneration subtype you increase its duration by %d%% + 1 rounded up.
		The effect will increase with your Mindpower.
surface_observation: 源文 fungus on your body 指身上的真菌，译文写成孢子
target:
你身上的孢子让回复效果更加持久。
		每当你获得一个回复类的增益效果，你会让它的持续时间增加 %d%% +1，向上取整。
		技能效果受精神强度加成。

surface_observation: 源文在 #LIGHT_GREEN# 后有两个空格，译文仅保留一个，改变了格式

source: You are exploring, press any key to stop.
target: 你正在自动探索，请按任意键停止。

source: Killed The Master, causing him to drop the Rod of Recall.
target: 杀死领主，使他掉落回归之杖。

surface_observation: Ring of Growth 的 Growth 被译为生命，名称含义明显改变

source:
Increases your critical damage multiplier by %d%%.
		The multiplier will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
增加 %d%% 暴击倍率。
		倍率受法术强度加成。

surface_observation: 原文仅说附近的一名生物，译文额外限定为随机目标

source: An oddly twisted club with a hefty weight on the end. There's something very strange about it.
target: 一根形态诡异的扭曲棍棒，末端坠着沉重的配重。它身上有些非常奇怪的东西。

source: A stocky dwarf, he looks angry.
target: 一名敦实的矮人，他看起来很生气。

source: I'm sorry but I need it. #LIGHT_GREEN#[keep the book]#LAST#
target: 对不起，但我需要它。#LIGHT_GREEN#[留下这本书]#LAST#

source:
#GOLD#Telepathy#LAST#
Allows you to sense any creatures even if they are not currently in your line of sight.
target:
#GOLD#心灵感应#LAST#
能让你心灵感应到任何生物，哪怕它不在你的视线范围内。

source:
#GOLD#Damage resistance: creature type#LAST#
All damage you receive from creatures of this type, through any means, is decreased by this percentage.  This is applied separately to (stacks with) normal resistances.
target:
#GOLD#伤害抗性：生物类型#LAST#
任何方式受到指定生物类型的伤害，不管造成伤害的方式是什么，都按此值减免。这一效果与普通伤害抗性各自独立生效。

deep_observation: 译文仅写“造成伤害”，遗漏原文 mind damage 的精神伤害类型。补查：tome，commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，game/modules/tome/data/talents/psionic/discharge.lua:162-170，doBacklash 取 math.min(value, t.getDamage(self, t))，普通及转移反击分支均调用 self:project(..., DamageType.MIND, ...)，179-181 的说明及显示计算也明确使用该伤害类型。
source:
Your subconscious now retaliates when you take damage.  If the attacker is within range (%d), you'll inflict mind damage equal to the Feedback gained from the attack or %0.2f, whichever is lower.
		This effect can only happen once per creature per turn.
		The damage will scale with your Mindpower.
surface_observation: 原文有两处换行及制表缩进，译文多出一处换行及缩进
target:
你的潜意识会报复那些伤害你的人。
		当攻击者在 %d 码范围内时，你会对目标造成伤害，伤害值为因承受此攻击而获得的反馈数值（但不超过 %0.2f）。
		此效果每回合对同一生物最多只能触发 1 次。
		受精神强度影响，伤害按比例加成。
